headline: Kai, a payroll print near 84,000 arrives at 8:30 with the ten-year easing off 24-year highs and futures leaning higher.
subline: September payrolls and Tesla deliveries land this morning, oil backs off its sanctions run, and bitcoin clears $86,000.
asof: Pre-market · futures and prices as of 4:06 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: September payrolls land at 8:30 this morning
items.sentence: Consensus sits near 84,000 new jobs, a print that could sway rate-hike expectations with the ten-year just under 24-year highs, per Charles Schwab.

items.title: Factory activity cools but keeps expanding
items.sentence: The ISM manufacturing index eased to 54.5 in September from 54.6, short of the 55 forecast, with prices still pushed by steel, aluminum and tariffs, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Oil backs off its sanctions-driven run
items.sentence: WTI slipped to $89.73 and Brent to $100.12 on Friday, both down more than 2 percent as the US-Iran risk premium cooled, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Bitcoin clears $86,000 ahead of the jobs print
items.sentence: CoinDesk has bitcoin near $86,400, up about 3.5 percent in 24 hours, with Citigroup lifting its 12-month target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume.

items.title: Tesla's third-quarter delivery count due before the open
items.sentence: Tesla's own compiled consensus points to 461,974 vehicles against Street estimates spanning 435,000 to 480,100, per Basenor.

items.title: US extends Iran sanctions to land transport
items.sentence: Washington escalated sanctions to cover Iran's land transportation sectors, the latest turn in a conflict that has kept crude near $90, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Trump ties Flydubai cockpit incident to Iran
items.sentence: He suggested Tehran may have had a role in a co-pilot's attempted crash of a passenger jet and hinted at emergency powers ahead of the midterms, per SBS News.

items.title: Seoul retires its prosecutors' office after 78 years
items.sentence: South Korea's new Prosecution Service and Serious Crime Investigation Agency opened Friday with their top leadership posts still unfilled, per SBS News.

items.title: Both chambers in play a month from midterms
items.sentence: Decision Desk HQ's forecast has Democrats slightly favored in the House and Republicans narrowly ahead in the Senate, with a sizable chance one party takes both.

items.title: Anthropic lines up $42 billion of compute
items.sentence: Broadcom and Anthropic agreed on $42 billion in financing to expand compute capacity over five years, per Tech Startups.

items.title: OpenAI courts $30 billion at $1.4 trillion
items.sentence: Bloomberg reporting relayed by The Neuron has OpenAI seeking $30 billion at a roughly $1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, even as Sam Altman calls a 2026 listing ill-advised.

items.title: Robinhood builds AI agents for nonstop trading
items.sentence: The brokerage unveiled agentic trading features with expanded weekend hours, pointing retail toward a market that never quite closes, per The Neuron.

items.title: Tencent books $7 billion of Oracle compute
items.sentence: A five-year deal gives Tencent access to roughly 100,000 advanced AI chips hosted in Southeast Asia, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Bank of England flags AI-linked debt risk
items.sentence: The central bank warned that AI-linked debt and stretched valuations could amplify losses if the promised productivity fails to arrive, per The Neuron.
